integrity: All stated formulas are analytic consequences of the proof and independently checked numerically on finite cases; finite checks alone are not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The result holds for four prescribed center-to-vertex diameter disks of a centered rectangle; it does not cover off-center anchors, arbitrary quadrilaterals or higher-dimensional boxes. Square endpoint follows known regular-polygon results. Classical circular-segment integration is credited; historical priority remains provisional.
title: A sharp twofold-overlap transition for rectangular Thales coverings
